comment: Menu system (docs/ui): message and control type enums, control/page/manager layouts, prototype fixes

values.name: MessageType_TextEntryDone
values.comment: sent to the textbox's parent page, which drops it (not in Page_SendMessage's switch) - effectively dead. Args: a1 = textbox. Returns: -. Sent by: TextBox_Update ('+' key, or focus leaves while editing); Text_SendMessage(0x53).

values.name: MessageType_ListAddColumn
values.comment: List. Args: a1 = width in % of the list, a2 = alignment (as 0x59). Returns: 1, or 0 if 5 columns exist. Sent by: C_GCPAUSE, P_NFSTATS, Menu_DisplayControllerStyleList.

values.name: MessageType_ListAddRow
values.comment: List. Args: a1 = row (5 cells of 0x8c: text or sprite), a2 = item value. Returns: 1. Sent by: Menu_AddRow, Menu_AddRowPercentage.

values.name: MessageType_AddItem
values.comment: List, Radio (Combo not). Args: a1 = char* text, a2 = item value (returned by 0x35). Returns: List: new item index; Radio: 1. Sent by: ~330 sites: page/control handlers, Menu_AddItemsToControl, List(0x19 word wrap).

values.name: MessageType_AddItemLabel
values.comment: List, Radio. Args: a1 = text label id (Txt_BindLabel), a2 = item value. Returns: as 0x10. Sent by: menu data (setup records).

values.name: MessageType_ScrollAddToMax
values.comment: Scroll. Args: a1 = delta added to max. Returns: 0. Sent by: List (item added/removed).

values.name: MessageType_ListRemoveItem
values.comment: List. Args: a1 = index (probable). Returns: 1 if removed. Sent by: none found.

values.name: MessageType_ScriptExitLoop
values.comment: Button, Checkbox, Combo, Label, List, Radio, Scroll, Spin, Text, Window. Args: -. Returns: Script_ExitLoop result. Sent by: none in code (menu scripts).

values.name: MessageType_ScrollHideBar
values.comment: Scroll. Args: - (sets +0x13c bit0: bar not drawn, input still works). Returns: 1. Sent by: none found.

values.name: MessageType_ScriptPlay
values.comment: Button, Checkbox, Label, List, Memo, Radio, Scroll, Spin, Text, Window. Args: a1 = script hashcode, a2 = flag. Returns: Script_Play_UISTUFF result. Sent by: none in code (menu scripts).

values.name: MessageType_ClearItems
values.comment: List, Radio. Args: -. Returns: List 1, Radio 0. Sent by: handlers (P_CNOPTIONS, P_MPBOTSETUP...), Menu_AddItemsToControl, Menu_CreateOptionBox.

values.name: MessageType_SetText
values.comment: Label; Button/Checkbox/Radio/Spin/Text pass it to their label; Memo. Args: a1 = char* (or 0); if a1 == 0, a2 = text label id; both 0 = blank. Returns: 1. Sent by: ~315 sites; menu data.

values.name: MessageType_ListSetCellText
values.comment: List. Args: a1 = row<<16 | column, a2 = char* (word-wraps into extra rows). Returns: 1. Sent by: C_GCPAUSE, P_NFSTATS, List (wrap).

values.name: MessageType_SetColour
values.comment: Label (+ owners). Args: a1 = colour; a2 = 0: fixed colour (auto highlight off, normal = highlight = a1); a2 != 0: tint only. Returns: 1. Sent by: Menu_UpdateWheel, handlers, Process_RunFrame (fade 0xe1).

values.name: MessageType_SetHighlightColour
values.comment: Label, List, Memo. Args: a1 = colour used when focused / cursor over. Returns: 1. Sent by: menu data (every control).

values.name: MessageType_SetNormalColour
values.comment: Label, List, Memo. Args: a1 = colour when not focused (faded to with process 0xe1). Returns: 1. Sent by: menu data (every control).

values.name: MessageType_SelectIndex
values.comment: List, Radio. Args: a1 = index. Returns: List: result of the 0x49 sent to the parent; Radio: same. Sent by: Menu_SelectItemInControl, Menu_PutCodenamesIntoControl, C_GCPAUSE, P_PAUSE (menu data has it but MenuManager_Create skips it).

values.name: MessageType_SelectItemByValue
values.comment: List, Radio. Args: a1 = item value, a2 = 1: silent (no 0x49 to the parent). Returns: 1 / result of 0x49. Sent by: ~50 sites (option pages).

values.name: MessageType_ListSetCurrentItemValue
values.comment: List. Args: a1 = value. Returns: 1. Sent by: none found.

values.name: MessageType_SetId
values.comment: Button, Scroll: control +0x20; Radio: value of the last item. Args: a1 = id / value. Returns: 1. Sent by: C_SBCNSELECT, C_SBNFCN (to C_SBCNOPTIONS).

values.name: MessageType_SetScript
values.comment: all except Page, Manager, Combo. Args: a1 = slot 0..6, a2 = script hashcode (slot table at +0x7c). Returns: 1. Sent by: menu data.

values.name: MessageType_SetCursor
values.comment: Manager. Args: a1 = control hashcode, or a1 = 0 and a2 = M_CONTROL*. Returns: 1 if found. Sent by: menu scripts (target manager), MenuManager_Create (0x10000002), Manager 0x5f, P_PAUSE, P_LANGUAGE....

values.name: MessageType_SetFont
values.comment: Label (sprintf name+suffix), List (a1 = 1/2/3 font id), Memo (font name). Args: a1 = font name or id. Returns: 1. Sent by: menu data (record 0xfffffff8, 32-char name), P_CREDITS, P_NFRESULTS....

values.name: MessageType_SetIcon
values.comment: Label (+ owners). Args: a1 = sprite hashcode (switches the label to icon mode). Returns: 1. Sent by: Menu_PlayIris, Menu_UpdateWheel, handlers; menu data.

values.name: MessageType_ScrollSetMax
values.comment: Scroll, Spin. Args: a1 = max. Returns: 1. Sent by: Radio, List (internal).

values.name: MessageType_ScrollSetMin
values.comment: Scroll, Spin. Args: a1 = min. Returns: 1. Sent by: none found.

values.name: MessageType_SetRange
values.comment: Scroll, Spin. Args: a1 = min, a2 = max. Returns: 1. Sent by: C_SB* handlers on 0x51, Memo_Update, Menu_PutCodenamesIntoControl.

values.name: MessageType_ListSetColumnWidth
values.comment: List. Args: a1 = column, a2 = width % (max 100). Returns: 1. Sent by: C_GCPAUSE, P_NFSTATS; menu data.

values.name: MessageType_SetPulseColour
values.comment: Label (+0x104), List (+0x540). Args: a1 = colour used when 0x70 pulsing is on. Returns: 1. Sent by: C_GCPAUSE, P_PAUSE.

values.name: MessageType_ListSetOption564
values.comment: List. Args: a1 = byte stored in +0x564 (unknown). Returns: 0. Sent by: none found.

values.name: MessageType_SetState
values.comment: Label, Button, Checkbox, Text, Scroll, Spin, Radio, List, Memo (control +0x7a). Args: a1 = 0 visible, 1 hidden, 2 shown but not selectable. Returns: 1. Sent by: ~200 sites; menu data.

values.name: MessageType_ListSetTopRow
values.comment: List. Args: a1 = first visible row. Returns: 1. Sent by: List (FUN_00090f20).

values.name: MessageType_SetIconRect
values.comment: Label. Args: a1 = x<<16|y, a2 = w<<16|h in the sprite sheet. Returns: 1. Sent by: Menu_PlayIris, C_RBMPSTART; menu data.

values.name: MessageType_SetValue
values.comment: Scroll (clamped, then 0x54 to parent), Spin (inverted), Checkbox (bool). Args: a1 = value. Returns: 1 / 0 out of range. Sent by: ~86 sites; menu data.

values.name: MessageType_GetText
values.comment: Label, Button, Memo. Args: -. Returns: char*. Sent by: C_KEYBOARD, C_RBMPCNAME.

values.name: MessageType_GetColour
values.comment: Label. Args: -. Returns: current tint. Sent by: Process_Create (fade).

values.name: MessageType_GetHighlightColour
values.comment: Label, List, Memo. Args: -. Returns: colour. Sent by: none found.

values.name: MessageType_GetNormalColour
values.comment: Label, List, Memo. Args: -. Returns: colour. Sent by: none found.

values.name: MessageType_GetNumItems
values.comment: List (count), Radio (count - 1), Combo (its list). Args: -. Returns: count. Sent by: XBox_DoSaveFlow, Menu_CreateOptionBox, MenuManager_Monitor.

values.name: MessageType_GetSelectedIndex
values.comment: List, Radio. Args: -. Returns: index. Sent by: C_GCPAUSE, Menu_PutCodenamesIntoControl, C_RBMPCNAME.

values.name: MessageType_GetSelectedItemValue
values.comment: List, Radio. Args: -. Returns: value given to 0x10/0x11 (0 if nothing selected). Sent by: ~55 sites.

values.name: MessageType_GetMax
values.comment: Scroll, Spin. Args: -. Returns: max. Sent by: Menu_UpdateWheel, Menu_UpdateCodenameWheel.

values.name: MessageType_GetControl
values.comment: every control type except Page and Manager. Args: -. Returns: M_CONTROL* (self). Sent by: ~60 sites; __Menu_SendDelayed, Page_Update, Menu_PlayIris.

values.name: MessageType_GetMin
values.comment: Scroll, Spin. Args: -. Returns: min. Sent by: Spin.

values.name: MessageType_GetSelectedItemText
values.comment: Radio (item text), Text (edit buffer). Args: -. Returns: char*. Sent by: Combo_Update (to its List, which ignores it).

values.name: MessageType_ListGetTopRow
values.comment: List. Args: -. Returns: row. Sent by: none found.

values.name: MessageType_GetId
values.comment: Button, Checkbox, Label, List, Radio, Scroll, Spin, Text. Args: -. Returns: control +0x20. Sent by: none found.

values.name: MessageType_GetIconSize
values.comment: Label. Args: -. Returns: w<<16|h. Sent by: none found.

values.name: MessageType_GetIconPos
values.comment: Label. Args: -. Returns: x<<16|y. Sent by: none found.

values.name: MessageType_GetValue
values.comment: Scroll (clamped), Spin, Checkbox, Radio (index). Args: -. Returns: value. Sent by: ~117 sites (P_TWEAKS, wheels, C_CHCH*).

values.name: MessageType_GetVisibleRows
values.comment: List (+0x500); Combo returns +0x718. Args: -. Returns: rows. Sent by: none found.

values.name: MessageType_CreateObject
values.comment: Manager: allocate + init by type (NEW_CONTROL +0x21); Page: add child. Args: a1 = NEW_CONTROL* (to Manager) / M_CONTROL* (to Page). Returns: new control or 0. Sent by: MenuManager_Create (record 0xfffffff9); Manager to the page.

values.name: MessageType_CreatePage
values.comment: Manager (Page_Init, list add, GoPage flags 0x19). Args: a1 = page hashcode. Returns: M_PAGE*. Sent by: MenuManager_Create (record 0xfffffff0).

values.name: MessageType_GoPage
values.comment: Manager. Args: a1 = page hashcode, a2 = flags (see below). Returns: 1. Sent by: ~56 sites; Menu_ChangePageCloseIris (delayed), Manager 0x5f; menu scripts.

values.name: MessageType_SetSidePage
values.comment: Manager (+0x1c4). Args: a1 = page hashcode or 0; sends 0x4d/0x4c to the old/new page. Returns: 1. Sent by: none found.

values.name: MessageType_Destroy
values.comment: all. Args: -. Returns: 0. Sent by: Manager/Page cascade, MenuManager_Delete.

values.name: MessageType_IsCursorOverFocused
values.comment: Page. Args: -. Returns: bool. Sent by: none found.

values.name: MessageType_Scroll
values.comment: List/Radio/Spin/Combo resync and forward; Page -> handlers (C_*); default script slot 3. Args: a1 = control; a2 = 0, or 1 when Radio re-announces after 0x54. Returns: handler result. Sent by: Scroll_Update (d-pad / left stick while focused), List/Rad

values.name: MessageType_TextChanged
values.comment: Page -> handlers. Args: a1 = textbox. Returns: -. Sent by: TextBox_Update (character added / deleted).

values.name: MessageType_Select
values.comment: Page -> P_ handler (a1 = page, a2 = control) then C_ handler (a1 = control); default script slot 2. Args: a1 = control. Returns: handler result. Sent by: Button/Checkbox/Label/Memo/Scroll updates: A pressed (START too when manager status > 3).

values.name: MessageType_PageEnter
values.comment: handlers (P_*); page window script slot 0. Args: a1 = page, a2 = previous page hashcode. Returns: -. Sent by: Manager GoPage / SetSidePage.

values.name: MessageType_PageLeave
values.comment: handlers; page window script slot 1. Args: a1 = page, a2 = GoPage flags (or 0). Returns: -. Sent by: Manager GoPage / SetSidePage, MenuManager_Delete.

values.name: MessageType_GainFocus
values.comment: handlers; default script slot 1. Args: a1 = new control. Returns: -. Sent by: Page_Update (control under the cursor changed).

values.name: MessageType_LoseFocus
values.comment: handlers; default script slot 4. Args: a1 = old control. Returns: -. Sent by: Page_Update.

values.name: MessageType_PageUpdate
values.comment: handlers (iris animation, message boxes). Args: a1 = page. Returns: -. Sent by: Page_Update, every frame while the manager takes input.

values.name: MessageType_ControlCreated
values.comment: handlers (init range/value); default script slot 0. Args: a1 = control. Returns: -. Sent by: MenuManager_Create after each control's records.

values.name: MessageType_MemoBack
values.comment: List/Radio/Spin treat it like 0x49; Page -> handlers. Args: a1 = control. Returns: -. Sent by: Memo_Update: B on a focused memo (controller 0 only).

values.name: MessageType_TextEndEntry
values.comment: Text (leave edit mode, sends 0x00); Page forwards. Args: -. Returns: 1. Sent by: none found.

values.name: MessageType_ValueSet
values.comment: List/Radio resync (Radio re-sends 0x49 a2=1); Page -> handlers (wheels redraw without animation). Args: a1 = control. Returns: -. Sent by: Scroll after 0x2e SetValue.

values.name: MessageType_SetPageOption
values.comment: Manager. Args: a1 = option (only 1 = navigation mode, page +0xc0), a2 = value. Returns: 1. Sent by: menu scripts.

values.name: MessageType_SetAlpha
values.comment: Label (sprite alpha, +0x1c |= 4), List (+0x544), Memo (+0x27c). Args: a1 = alpha (0..0x80). Returns: 1. Sent by: none found.

values.name: MessageType_ListSetColumnAlign
values.comment: List (+0x51c[col]). Args: a1 = column, a2 = alignment. Returns: 1. Sent by: C_GCPAUSE, P_PAUSE, Menu_CreateOptionBox, P_ENDMISSION, XBox_DoSaveFlow.

values.name: MessageType_SetPlayerFocus
values.comment: Manager: page +0xb0[player] = control; 0x60 to the old, 0x5c to the new. Args: a1 = control hashcode, a2 = player 0..3. Returns: 1 if found. Sent by: P_MPJOIN, C_RBMP* (multiplayer setup).

values.name: MessageType_PlayerFocusGained
values.comment: handlers (C_RBMP*). Args: a1 = control. Returns: -. Sent by: Manager 0x5a.

values.name: MessageType_AltSelect1
values.comment: Radio/List forward; Page -> P_ then C_ handler. Args: a1 = control. Returns: -. Sent by: Button/Label/Memo/Scroll updates: Y pressed (ACTION_MENU_ALTSELECT_1).

values.name: MessageType_AltSelect2
values.comment: as 0x5d. Args: a1 = control. Returns: -. Sent by: Button/Label/Memo/Scroll updates: X pressed (ACTION_MENU_ALTSELECT_2).

values.name: MessageType_Back
values.comment: Manager: 0x6b veto query, then pop the page stack (GoPage flags 5|8), or 0x63 when empty. Args: a1 = 0 normal / 1 forced (no 0x6b), a2 = player. Returns: 1. Sent by: MenuManager_Update (B / BACK), handlers, delayed.

values.name: MessageType_PlayerFocusLost
values.comment: handlers. Args: a1 = control. Returns: -. Sent by: Manager 0x5a.

values.name: MessageType_SelectRepeat
values.comment: Page -> handlers (C_KEYBOARD). Args: a1 = control. Returns: -. Sent by: Button_Update: A held (auto-repeat).

values.name: MessageType_SetTextFlag2000
values.comment: Label (+0x10e -> text sprite flag 0x2000), List (+0x567). Args: a1 = bool. Returns: 1. Sent by: P_PAUSE, P_ENDMISSION, C_KEYPAD.

values.name: MessageType_BackAtRoot
values.comment: handlers (P_MPSCENARIO, P_NFMAP go to P_MAIN); page window script slot 2. Args: a1 = page, a2 = page hashcode. Returns: -. Sent by: Manager 0x5f with an empty page stack.

values.name: MessageType_MemoSetOption280
values.comment: Memo (+0x280 byte). Args: a1 = byte. Returns: 1. Sent by: P_NFRESULTS.

values.name: MessageType_MemoGetNumLines
values.comment: Memo (+0x281). Args: -. Returns: line count. Sent by: Menu_CreateOptionBox, XBox_DoSaveFlow, MenuManager_Monitor.

values.name: MessageType_MemoSetOption282
values.comment: Memo (+0x282 byte). Args: a1 = byte. Returns: 0. Sent by: same as 0x65, P_MPDEBRIEFING.

values.name: MessageType_LockInput
values.comment: Manager (+0x1d4; clears all actions). Args: a1 = 1 lock / 0 unlock. Returns: 1. Sent by: P_* handlers, Menu_ChangePageCloseIris, Menu_PlayMovie/StopMovie, MenuManager_Monitor, GoPage (unlocks).

values.name: MessageType_ScrollNoWrap
values.comment: Scroll (+0x144 wrap = 0, +0x145 proportional bar = 1). Args: -. Returns: 1. Sent by: P_CNAVOPTIONS.

values.name: MessageType_SaveFlowDone
values.comment: handlers (P_CNMENU). Args: a1 = page, a2 = result. Returns: -. Sent by: XBox_DoSaveFlow, C_LBERROPTIONS.

values.name: MessageType_QueryBack
values.comment: handlers. Args: a1 = control/page, a2 = int*: write 0xfffffffe to keep the page. Returns: -. Sent by: Manager 0x5f (to the player's focused control, then the page).

values.name: MessageType_SetIconSpriteFlags
values.comment: Label (+0xec). Args: a1 = sprite flags. Returns: 1. Sent by: P_PAUSE, P_ENDMISSION.

values.name: MessageType_BackOnControl
values.comment: List forwards; Page -> P_ then C_ handler (C_LB*OPTIONS). Args: a1 = control. Returns: -. Sent by: Scroll_Update: B on a focused scroll (lists/wheels).

values.name: MessageType_PageResume
values.comment: handlers (P_MPBOTS...). Args: a1 = page, a2 = previous page hashcode. Returns: -. Sent by: Manager GoPage with flag 8 and not 0x10.

values.name: MessageType_SetInputDelay
values.comment: Page (+0xcc). Args: a1 = frames after entering before input is taken. Returns: 0. Sent by: P_START.

values.name: MessageType_SetPulse
values.comment: Label (+0x10f), List (+0x568). Args: a1 = bool. Returns: 0. Sent by: P_LANGUAGE, XBox_DoSaveFlow.

values.name: MessageType_ListSetSelectionColour
values.comment: List (+0x548). Args: a1 = colour (guess). Returns: 0. Sent by: P_NFSTATS.

values.name: MessageType_GetCurrentPage
values.comment: Manager. Args: -. Returns: hashcode of the current page (or of the page under an overlay). Sent by: none found.

values.name: MessageType_SetLineSpacing
values.comment: List, Memo. Args: a1 = row height in % of the font height (sets visible rows). Returns: 0. Sent by: C_GCPAUSE, P_PAUSE, Menu_CreateOptionBox, MenuManager_Monitor....

values.name: MessageType_SetAlwaysHighlighted
values.comment: Label (+0x110). Args: a1 = bool. Returns: 0. Sent by: P_MPBOTSETUP.

values.name: ControlType_Button
values.comment: Button_*; M_BUTTON 0x1ac; label at +0x94; prefix GO_ in handler names

values.name: ControlType_Checkbox
values.comment: Checkbox_*; 0x1ac; value byte +0x1a8; prefix CH

values.name: ControlType_Combo
values.comment: Combo_*; 0x71c; label + list

values.name: ControlType_Label
values.comment: Label_*; M_LABEL 0x114; also the iris/wheel picture

values.name: ControlType_List
values.comment: List_*; M_LIST 0x56c; scroll at +0x128; prefix LB (list box). also a target of ui.h's SCROLL_* macros

values.name: ControlType_Manager
values.comment: M_MANAGER 0x1d8

values.name: ControlType_Page
values.comment: M_PAGE 0xd0

values.name: ControlType_Radio
values.comment: Radio_*; 0x308; label +0x94, scroll +0x1a8; prefix RB; a left/right option picker (label + embedded Scroll holding the index), the usual target of the ui.h SCROLL_* macros

values.name: ControlType_Scroll
values.comment: Scroll_*; M_SCROLL 0x148; value/min/max slider; the iris wheels are Scroll controls (prefix SB)

values.name: ControlType_Spin
values.comment: Spin_*; 0x318; label + scroll, value inverted

values.name: ControlType_Text
values.comment: Text_*/TextBox_Update; M_TEXTBOX 0x9b0; on-screen character grid

values.name: ControlType_Window
values.comment: Window_*; 0x9c; a page's background/script holder (Window_Get)

values.name: ControlType_Memo
values.comment: Memo_*; 0x284; multi-line text with scroll at +0x94

types.name: M_CONTROL
types.comment: The part every control, page and the manager share

fields.name: parent
fields.comment: the page for a control, the manager for a page

fields.name: drawState
fields.comment: 0x10 normal, 0x20 focused, 0x40 pressed, 0x80 under the cursor

fields.name: state
fields.comment: SetState: bit 0 hidden, bit 1 not selectable

types.name: M_WIDGET
types.comment: An ordinary control: M_CONTROL, then its default scripts

types.name: MPJoinSlot
types.comment: A controller's place on the join page (4 at 0x245240)

fields.name: controllerPort
fields.comment: the controller port: Menu_AllJoinedPlayersReady writes it, P_MPCONFIRM copies it into PlayerInputs[].controllerPort
